hypothesis: Causal block skipping in the prefill kernel: for causal launches, each m-block iterates KV only up to min((start_m+1)*BLOCK_M, SEQ_KV) instead of the whole sequence, split into an unmasked phase over KV blocks fully below the diagonal (no bounds/causal mask, unmasked K/V loads) and a masked phase over the diagonal block(s) only.
rationale: The current prefill path loops over all SEQ_KV for every query block and applies the causal mask everywhere, so about half the QK^T/PV work and K/V traffic is on fully masked tiles. Prefill rows are at ~0.35x FA2 and dominate the geomean deficit; FA2 already skips these tiles. Removing mask arithmetic from off-diagonal tiles also trims the inner loop. Decode/split path untouched.
expected_effect: Roughly 1.8-2x faster on all five prefill rows (prefill score ~0.36x -> ~0.65-0.7x FA2), decode unchanged; whole-table geomean up ~30%.
